content: This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for guidance from your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Side Effects: Common side effects may include vaginal or urethral burning, itching, pain, or lower abdominal cramps. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other azole antifungal agents (such as terconazole or fluconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Ask your doctor whether it is safe to engage in sexual intercourse while using this product. Be aware that this medication may weaken rubber products such as latex condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps, potentially leading to failure and an increased risk of pregnancy. Do not use these products during treatment with this medication. If you are pregnant, do not use this medication for self-treatment. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. If you are pregnant, follow your doctor’s instructions on how to use the applicator to insert this medication. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication may be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Prevention of Vaginal Yeast Infections: To help prevent vaginal yeast infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. For formulary information, contact the applicable plan provider for the most current details.
